WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS cc_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 2) AS share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2;

SELECT d.fiscal_period, MIN(d.calendar_date) AS start_d, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS end_d,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_sales_keys,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_orders,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1,return_ts_utc,quantity_returned HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_returns
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
         MIN(sale_date) AS sd, MIN(store_key) AS sk, MAX(channel_code) AS ch
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ch, COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(n) AS rows_, MIN(ids) AS min_ids, MAX(ids) AS max_ids, MIN(loads) AS minloads, MAX(loads) AS maxloads
FROM dups JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = dups.sd
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3;

SELECT s.store_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type IS NULL AS no_order, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3;

WITH wd AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT wd.dispatch_date AS bd, wd.fulfilment_type AS ft, f.net_amount AS amt, 'sale' AS kind, 900 AS bk_store
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 'ret', s.store_id
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period AS fp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bk_store=900 THEN amt END) AS web_net_900,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' AND bk_store=900 THEN amt END) AS cc_900,
    SUM(amt) AS web_net_all_ret,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN amt END) AS cc_all_ret
  FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.bd
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period AS fp, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
  WHERE c.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.fp, a.web_net_900, c.ctl_net, ROUND(100.0*a.cc_900/a.web_net_900,2) AS share_900,
       ROUND(100.0*a.cc_all_ret/a.web_net_all_ret,2) AS share_all_returns
FROM agg a JOIN ctl c USING (fp) ORDER BY 1;
